question: Who are the top 10 key figures or founders in Quantum Sensing currently? Give me 100 word explanation and the rank
answer:
Here is a ranked list of the top 10 key figures or founders currently shaping the field of quantum sensing, along with a concise 100‑word explanation for each:

1. **Brenton Young & Mark Kasevich (AOSense)** – Co‑founders of AOSense (2004), pioneers in cold‑atom interferometry for precision navigation, timing, and gravity sensing, delivering portable, lab‑grade quantum sensors to defense and space agencies ([v-mr.biz](https://v-mr.biz/quantum-sensors-market?utm_source=openai)).  
2. **Kyle Hardman, Paul Wigley & Christian Freier (Nomad Atomics)** – Founded Nomad Atomics (2018), developing compact cold‑atom gravimeters for gravity, acceleration, and time measurement ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2021/02/18/14-quantum-sensor-companies-manufacturing-superior-instrumentation-to-revolutionize-the-industry/?utm_source=openai)).  
3. **Bruno Desruelle, Philippe Bouyer & Arnaud Landragin (Muquans)** – Co‑founders of Muquans (2011), the only company commercializing laser‑cooled atom quantum sensors for geophysics and metrology ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2021/02/18/14-quantum-sensor-companies-manufacturing-superior-instrumentation-to-revolutionize-the-industry/?utm_source=openai)).  
4. **Dr. Graeme Malcolm & Dr. Gareth Maker (M Squared Lasers)** – Founded M Squared (2006), delivering laser and photonics systems enabling quantum accelerometers, clocks, and sensors ([quantum.org.uk](https://quantum.org.uk/tags/sensing/?utm_source=openai)).  
5. **Gianvito Lucivero, Annalisa Volpe & Domenico Tulli (QSENSATO)** – Founded QSENSATO (2024), developing chip‑based atomic‑photonic sensors for ultra‑precise electric and magnetic field detection ([quantum.org.uk](https://quantum.org.uk/tags/sensing/?utm_source=openai)).  
6. **Founders of QT Sense (UMCG spin‑out)** – Established QT Sense (2024), creating nanodiamond‑based quantum sensors for single‑cell diagnostics, enabling rapid sepsis detection ([quantum.org.uk](https://quantum.org.uk/tags/sensing/?utm_source=openai)).  
7. **Founders of QuPrayog (IISER Pune spin‑out)** – Founded QuPrayog (2024), building portable optical atomic clocks and frequency combs for ultra‑precise timing and navigation ([quantum.org.uk](https://quantum.org.uk/tags/sensing/?utm_source=openai)).  
8. **Founders of Vector Atomic** – Founded Vector Atomic (2018), developing cold‑atom inertial navigation systems (gyroscopes, accelerometers, magnetometers) for GPS‑free navigation; acquired by IonQ in 2025 ([quantum.org.uk](https://quantum.org.uk/tags/sensing/?utm_source=openai)).  
9. **Kevin Berghoff, Kristina Liu & Fleming Bruckmaier (Quantum Diamonds)** – Founded Quantum Diamonds, commercializing diamond NV‑center quantum sensors for nanoscale magnetic imaging ([quantum.org.uk](https://quantum.org.uk/categories/quantum-sensing/?utm_source=openai)).  
10. **Federico Capasso** – A leading physicist whose invention of the quantum cascade laser has become foundational for mid‑infrared quantum sensing and spectroscopy ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federico_Capasso?utm_source=openai)).

Each of these individuals or teams has played a pivotal role in advancing quantum sensing technologies across navigation, medical diagnostics, metrology, and spectroscopy.
